svg.title: Every first-draw history determines the remaining contents for the second draw
svg.desc: A bag begins with six red and four blue counters, total ten. Draw two counters uniformly without replacement. R subscript i means draw i is red, B subscript i means draw i is blue. The first-red branch has probability six tenths and reaches five red plus four blue, total nine. Its second-red and second-blue rates are five ninths and four ninths. The first-blue branch has probability four tenths and reaches six red plus three blue, total nine. Its second-red and second-blue rates are six ninths and three ninths. The four joint route weights are RR one third, RB four fifteenths, BR four fifteenths, BB two fifteenths. They sum to one. Different colours means RB or BR, giving eight fifteenths. The first colour drawn determines which numerator is reduced; the denominator falls to nine on both reached histories.
